setting: You all grew up in Liverpool and still live in Merseyside, within an hour of each other, and the flat you are clearing belonged to your nan in Walton, where she lived for over forty years. You know each other as siblings who have shared a childhood, family rows and a lot of Sunday dinners. You already know that your nan has left a lot of stuff behind and that none of you wants to be the one who has to decide what goes.
opener: Sends a photo of the kitchen drawer full of Nan's handwritten labels and asks who wants to take what home.

Gemma.knows: You know Craig is your younger brother, who is practical and will fix anything you hand him. You know Priya is your youngest sister, who is organised and tends to take charge when things get messy.
Gemma.like: You are warm and a bit anxious, and you care about getting things right for everyone.
Gemma.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly when something needs organising.
Gemma.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use the occasional emoji.

Craig.knows: You know Gemma is your big sister, who likes to be in control and sends long messages when she is stressed. You know Priya is your little sister, who you can always count on to say what you're all thinking.
Craig.like: You are easygoing and dry, and you prefer to get on with things rather than talk about them.
Craig.texts: You message the group only occasionally without being asked, usually when you have something practical to add.
Craig.style: You type in short lowercase lines with little punctuation and almost no emoji.

Priya.knows: You know Gemma is your eldest sister, who tends to take charge and worries too much about the rest of you. You know Craig is your older brother, who is solid and reliable but hard to read.
Priya.like: You are honest and direct, and you have a dry sense of humour that people sometimes take the wrong way.
Priya.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, usually to check in or to share something funny.
Priya.style: You type in standard sentences with proper punctuation, and you use the odd laughing emoji.

private_lines.Gemma: You live in Huyton with your husband Steve and your two teenagers, and you work part-time as a receptionist at a primary school. Your days run on school runs, a bit of housework and lots of phone calls, and you are usually the one everyone rings when something needs sorting.
private_lines.Craig: You live alone in Kirkby, where you run a small electrical contracting business with a van and a couple of regular jobs each week. Your days start early, you spend most of them up ladders or under floors, and you come home tired and quiet.
private_lines.Priya: You live in Wavertree with your partner Sam, and you work as a staff nurse on shifts at the Royal, so your week changes from one to the next. When you're on days you get home wrecked, and when you're on nights you sleep in the afternoon, so you're often not around at the usual times.

situation: Siblings clearing out a grandparent's flat.

text:
[photo: kitchen drawer full of elastic bands, string and batteries, every bag and tin labelled in Nan's handwriting]
Right, this is the kitchen drawer. Every bit of string, every elastic band, and she's labelled half of it 😩 Who wants to take what home? I'm not deciding on my own.
"SCISSORS (GOOD)" 😂
what's the drawer with the batteries
Yes the one with the batteries. Half of them are dead, I tested them
bin the dead ones
I'm not binning anything with her writing on it
I'll take the labels. Not the drawer, just the labels
Priya that's a very weird thing to want
Don't care. I want "DON'T" on the back of the tin
ill have the tools under the sink if nobody's touched them
Nobody's touched them. Steve asked if you want the spare ladder too, he's been eyeing it in ours
dont need the ladder got two
Ok I'll tell Steve. Priya can you do Thursday? I've got school pickup Wednesday and Steve's got the kids
I'm on nights from Wed. Thursday morning I'm off, I can do it. Sam's coming to help carry
Perfect 🙏
Has anyone found her reading glasses? I'm sure they were on the windowsill
Check her coat pocket. She always kept a pair in there for bingo
Found them. Also found a Werther's Original that's clearly from 2019, so I'm not sure what else is going to be in there
bin the werthers
Craig
is the gas still on
I think so? The meter was ticking when I came in. Don't touch it, I'll ring the supplier tomorrow
Gemma you're not supposed to ring suppliers at 10pm
I'm not, I'm putting it on the list so I don't forget 😅
ill check the cooker is off thurs when im there
I'm on days Tuesday so I'll be wrecked. Don't expect me before 2
Right, I'm off to bed. Have a think about the drawer 🙏
Ok
Home. Knackered. Gemma did you actually ring the gas people or was that a joke
I rang at 8 exactly and got put on hold for 40 mins 🙄 they say someone will come out to read the meter but not until the 2nd
Don't touch anything in the meantime Craig
cooker's off. checked it wed night
dont need to be in there to know that
You went round on Wednesday?
drove past. light was off in the kitchen
Ok 😅 thanks
Woke up at 1 and couldn't get back off. Sam's making me a sandwich, I'm not complaining
Are you going to sleep properly tonight or are you back on
Back on Wed. Tonight I'm off, so I'll be out cold by 11
Good 🙏
who's got the key to the back gate
Nan's key ring is in the blue bowl by the door. The one with the Blackpool tower on it
got it
Has anyone got a number for the man who did the boiler? Mum said he came out in 2017 and was quite good
No idea. Try the card on the fridge, Nan kept everything
There's about 40 cards on the fridge 😩
the one with the cat on
How do you know
it was on the fridge when i was there in the summer
Found it, thank you 🙏
Thursday, is it still just the two of you? Want me to come round for lunch after, I can bring sandwiches
Yeah just me and Sam. Lunch sounds good, Sam likes your sandwiches more than mine
ill be there after the van job, say about 12
Ok I'll get the good bread 😊
Morning. Has anyone got the number for the skip people? Steve says we need one if we're clearing the back yard too
ill sort the skip. dont ring them before 10 they dont pick up
Ok. Thank you 🙏
skip booked for fri. 8 yard
I was literally about to ring them 😅
you were about to ring them and then do school run
That's fair
Just woke up. Sam says I was talking in my sleep about bingo
Were you talking about the Werther's
Apparently yes
Gemma is the Werther's in the bin or not
Still in my handbag. Not binned, not eaten 😩
bin it
Craig
van's in for a battery. might be late thurs, be there by 12:30
Ok. I'll save you a sandwich
dont save me one
On my way in. Nights, pray for me. Sam's bringing me a flask at 2 so I won't starve
Good luck 🙏 don't let them give you the bad biscuits
Steve wants to know if the ladder's still in the hallway or if you've taken it
its in the hallway. ive got two in the van
Ok. I'll tell him to wait
tell him he can have it. just dont let him carry it on his own
Break. Cuppa and a Twix. Nobody talk to me 😂
Actually I'm glad you're all asleep, that means nobody's going to ask me about the drawer
